To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
smokers who intend to quit but do not feel capable to do so are more likely to be found among those who have failed to quit smoking before.
smokers with a past unsuccessful quit attempt, who intend to quit but feel they are not capable to do so, are the most difficult to motivate to change.
